text: The Northern Rivers Agricultural Drainage Reset Program is a two-year pilot initiative aimed at restoring and upgrading agricultural drainage systems in the Northern Rivers region of New South Wales, Australia. The program seeks to mitigate flood risks and enhance agricultural productivity by cleaning, repairing, and upgrading drainage networks that were damaged during the 2022 floods. It involves collaboration between various public organizations and is part of a broader disaster recovery framework.
